title: Internal memo
description: A one-page internal memorandum on organization letterhead, handed to a player. Terse operational language; short labelled paragraphs (Impact / Status / Request) work well.

orgName.description: Organization on the letterhead (defaults to brand.aliases.org)

department.description: Issuing department under the organization name

date.description: Date and time as written on the memo

urgency.description: Urgency: urgent and emergency print a colored banner across the top

body.description: Memo body. Blank lines separate paragraphs; newlines are kept.
examples:
Ops,

We have a major issue.

signatureBlock.description: Name and title under the body (newlines kept)
examples:
BHS Duty Manager
Baggage Handling Systems Control Room

initials.description: Handwritten initials next to the FROM line, as on a signed paper memo

classification.description: Handling marking printed in the footer
